color.note: Phone tokens follow the system appearance (light first, dark second). Dark keeps the existing plum surfaces from ResearchUI.m (TIOPaper 23,19,27; cell 34,29,37; TIOInk 240,237,229; TIOAccent 219,246,122). lens-* tokens are the glasses' green-mono intensity ramp and are identical in both themes.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Screen background behind inset-grouped lists (UIKit systemGroupedBackground in light; TIOPaper in dark).

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Grouped cells, sheets and cards on bg (secondarySystemGroupedBackground in light; the existing cell plum in dark).

tokens.name: bg-sunken
tokens.usage: Segmented-control track, text-field fill and inactive switch track on bg-raised.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Primary text and SF Symbols on bg and bg-raised (TIOInk in dark).

tokens.name: label-secondary
tokens.usage: Row subtitles, section headers and footers on bg and bg-raised. 4.7:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: label-tertiary
tokens.usage: Disabled rows and placeholder text only; never for information the user needs (below 4.5:1).

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows. Decorative; rows are also separated by spacing.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Tint: links, chevron-free actions, switches, selected segments and accent text on bg and bg-raised. Light is a deep olive-lime (6.1:1 on white); dark is the original TIOAccent lime (13.8:1 on bg-raised).

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Filled primary button and the Glasses hub-icon tile. Text and glyphs on it use on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on accent-fill (6.1:1 light, 15.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted (secondary) button fill and selected-row wash; its text is accent (5.4:1 light, 11.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: tile-assistant
tokens.usage: Hub icon tile for the Assistant section (systemIndigo); glyph is white.

tokens.name: tile-media
tokens.usage: Hub icon tile for the Media section (systemPink, darkened in light so the white glyph holds 5.3:1).

tokens.name: tile-developer
tokens.usage: Hub icon tile for the Developer section (systemGray); glyph is white.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Connected / up to date. Always paired with a word and a symbol (checkmark.circle.fill), never color alone.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: Needs attention (low battery, update ready). Paired with exclamationmark.triangle.fill and a word.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons and failures. Paired with xmark.octagon.fill and a word.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard / Full Keyboard Access focus ring, 3px solid; 3:1 or better on every phone surface.

tokens.name: lens-black
tokens.usage: Glasses: transparent. Black emits no light on the waveguide, so it is the container color. Never draw filled panels.

tokens.name: lens-full
tokens.usage: Glasses: primary content in band B (turn, distance, current lyric, timer, answer) and the focus caret. 255 on the 8-bit ramp.

tokens.name: lens-high
tokens.usage: Glasses: secondary text in band M and the transient hint. 176 on the ramp; 7.2:1 against black.

tokens.name: lens-mid
tokens.usage: Glasses: ambient text in band T at 18px or larger, unfocused menu icons, map roads. 119 on the ramp (existing 0x007700).

tokens.name: lens-track
tokens.usage: Glasses: progress tracks and dividers only, never text (existing 0x003800).

tokens.name: lens-guide
tokens.usage: Design-time only: band outlines and annotations in previews. Never shipped to the glasses.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "PingFang SC", "Helvetica Neue", system-ui, sans-serif
families.display: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "PingFang SC", "Helvetica Neue", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: title2
styles.usage: UIFontTextStyleTitle2. Empty-state and wizard step titles.

styles.name: title3
styles.usage: UIFontTextStyleTitle3. Card headings in the OTA wizard and navigation panel.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: UIFontTextStyleHeadline. Button labels and emphasized row titles.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: UIFontTextStyleBody. Row titles and running text. Replaces Font(16, Regular).

styles.name: subheadline
styles.usage: UIFontTextStyleSubheadline. Row subtitles. Replaces Font(13, Regular).

styles.name: footnote
styles.sample: Looks up lyrics on lrclib.net using only the song title, artist, and duration.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: UIFontTextStyleCaption1. Metadata under previews; pair with monospaced digits for sizes and hashes.

groups.name: Glasses (stock vector font, px at 24.8 px/°)

styles.name: lens-hero
styles.usage: ≈1.94° (116′). Band B only, one item per page: the Pomodoro timer. Native pages only.

styles.name: lens-primary
styles.usage: ≈1.29° (77′). Band B headline: distance, ETA countdown. Native pages only.

styles.name: lens-title
styles.usage: ≈0.97° (58′). Band B second line or a focused item label; the current lyric.

styles.name: lens-body
styles.usage: ≈0.81° (48′). Band M secondary text and caption lines.

styles.name: lens-label
styles.sample: Passing Martin Luther King Jr Blvd
styles.usage: ≈0.73° (44′). Band T ambient text and the transient hint.

styles.name: lens-min
styles.usage: ≈0.65° (39′ em, about 27′ cap height). The floor: map scale, page counters. Never smaller; 14px is removed from the ramp.

spacing.note: Phone spacing is in points on a 4-pt grid. lens-* spacing is in glasses pixels.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside a pill; text-line gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Stack spacing between a title and its subtitle block; glasses gutter between a glyph and its text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding (replaces 11) and gap between buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row and card horizontal padding (layout margins). Glasses side inset.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Hub row leading: icon tile to title.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding; gap between wizard cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between unrelated sections inside a scroll view.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Glasses focus caret ends and progress-track caps.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: 30×30 hub icon tiles (TIOHubIcon).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Lens preview surface, map card, text fields.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Inset-grouped sections; set by UIKit, listed so mockups match.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons (UIButtonConfiguration capsule), status pills.

size.note: Fixed sizes the phone UI must respect.

tokens.name: hit-min
tokens.usage: Minimum tappable size in both axes (HIG). Buttons are at least 50pt tall.

tokens.name: icon-tile
tokens.usage: Hub row icon tile; SF Symbol inside at 15pt semibold.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Primary and secondary full-width buttons.

lens.note: Glasses geometry. lens-ppd is an unverified estimate (23.5° diagonal over the 540×220 window); every angle here is lens px ÷ lens-ppd. Change this one number after an on-device measurement.

tokens.name: lens-page-w
tokens.usage: App page and menu width.

tokens.name: lens-page-h
tokens.usage: App page height (app.c rejects anything past y 180).

tokens.name: lens-menu-h
tokens.usage: Menu canvas height (focus_menu.c).

tokens.name: lens-reserve-top
tokens.usage: y 0–12 on pages (0–12 on the menu): always empty. Room for the display-height and depth shift.

tokens.name: lens-band-t
tokens.usage: Band T (ambient), page rows y 12–56 ≈ 1.8°. Status, title, road being passed, transient hint.

tokens.name: lens-band-m
tokens.usage: Band M (secondary), y 56–112 ≈ 2.3°. Supporting detail, the next lyric, the question.

tokens.name: lens-band-b
tokens.usage: Band B (primary), y 112–172 ≈ 2.4°. The one thing the page is for. Closest to the natural line of sight.

tokens.name: lens-reserve-bottom
tokens.usage: y 172–180: kept clear of edge falloff.

tokens.name: lens-inset-x
tokens.usage: Side inset (x 16–524). Matches the existing footer slot.

tokens.name: lens-core-x
tokens.usage: Core zone for band-B primary text, inside the binocular overlap. Edges hold only glyphs or ambient items.

tokens.name: lens-caret
tokens.usage: Focus caret: 24×3 bar in lens-full, 4px below the focused item's baseline.

tokens.name: lens-hint-ms
tokens.usage: Transient hint lifetime after page entry or the last input.

tokens.name: lens-move-ms
tokens.usage: Focus and caret move, cubic ease-out (focus_menu.c). Page change 120ms. Map blend 180ms.
